convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (MomentumCandleSign) which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all position open/close logic including money management

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time assignment
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA operates

other_exits: Historical bar scan: when both open and close are enabled for a side but no close signal on SignalBar, EA scans backward from SignalBar+1 through all bars looking for the first opposing signal to set the close flag

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin, BALANCE=MM fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=MM fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: SignalBar input controls which bar is read for signals (default=1, previous bar). When SignalBar=0, the EA processes every tick instead of only on new bars. The historical bar scan logic (lines 123-149) is an unusual feature: if both open and close flags are enabled for a side but no close signal was found on the SignalBar, the EA iterates through all historical bars to find the earliest opposing signal and sets the close flag accordingly. This acts as a safety net to ensure opposite-side positions get closed even if the close signal appeared on a bar older than SignalBar. All actual trade execution is delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_).
python_conversion_notes: The MomentumCandleSign custom indicator must be ported first since its buffer values drive all entry/exit logic. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all order execution and the MarginMode money management logic - this must be reimplemented in Python. The four margin modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) require account equity/balance/margin queries. The historical bar scan for close signals is an edge case that must be faithfully replicated. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 are in points (not pips), so for 5-digit brokers these are 100/200 pips - no explicit digit adjustment is done in the EA itself but the values are already point-based.
